prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1195; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported headache, light sensitivity, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the presentation is plausible for a crash of this type. Across four visits, the patient was managed with symptom monitoring, cognitive rest guidance, and graduated return-to-activity planning. Recovery took somewhat longer than is typical for a concussion of this severity, and follow-up was extended accordingly. Imaging and neurological examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis of concussion. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known. Billing records show two similar charges on the same date of service, which are currently being reviewed for accuracy and duplication. Clinical management is ongoing, with return to full activity expected once symptoms resolve.
